thread:
ana: quick heads-up — new quant canary showed a parse regression on toolcall suite this morning (small but clear). infra-bot: canary 17286 report -> https://infradash/redwood/canaries/17286 :warning:
tariq: what changed in the canary?
jana: quant profile = per-channel int8, act clip=0.95, batch-window 40ms. prompts unchanged.
julia: sample error:
ERROR: JSONDecodeError at line 1 column 1
RESPONSE PREVIEW: "\u0003{\"action\":\"update\",\"args\":{}}"
looks like a controlchar prefix in several outputs.
tariq: control chars often mean first-token drift. could be encoding table mapping under quant.
jana: I ran 20 failing traces: concentrated when response is short and starts with '{' immediately. model emits 0x03 or 0x00 leading bytes occasionally.
julia: mitigation plan:
- quick streaming scrub: drop leading nonprintables before parse
- add onboarding test: sample N generations and fail if any nonprintable prefix > 0
- collect token-level first-token histogram for 1% of traffic
ariq: agreed. scrub as short-term; but gating needed to catch this earlier on quant onboarding.
nana: scrub PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/7502 — small sanitizer, unit tests included.
infra-bot: scrub deploy started on canary pool commit=b4f5 est=3m
tariq: I'll run a microbench comparing kvcache on/off to see if prefix behavior correlates with prefix reuse. will share results in this thread.
nana: thanks — let's reconvene after microbench and canary metrics. :thumbsup:
